## Checklist

- [ ] Targets the `main` branch
- [ ] No code comments and no emojis in code or docs
- [ ] Clear, readable names; files stay short and organized
- [ ] Commit messages are a single short subject line
- [ ] `bun run check` passes
- [ ] `cargo test --lib` passes in `src-tauri`
- [ ] README updated if behaviour changed
